thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: [sev2] multiple serve-runtime pods in us-west-2 (serve-pool-prod) reporting Evicted / CrashLoopBackOff. Potential customer impact: increases in 5xx and degraded latency for embeddings and chat. Root TS: 2123456789

maria_oncall: I'm taking this. Seeing repeated ephemeral-storage evictions on nodes gke-usw2-serve-* and immediate container crashes for modelcache + runtime. @tom_sre can you join? :wave:

 tom_sre: on it. hitting the cluster now. quick check: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -o wide | grep Evicted` shows ~6 pods evicted across 3 nodes.

 eli_runtime: i have logs from one of the crashed pods, modelcache dies with: ```
[ERROR] modelcache: write /tmp/model-cache/1234/tmp: no space left on device
runtime: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
Caused by: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 256MB
```

 jen_support: Customers reporting intermittent 503s for the embeddings endpoint (us-west). I notified SRE escalation list and product.

 tom_sre: looks like two issues colliding: (1) ephemeral disk usage high (logs + temp model shards) leading to k8s eviction; (2) subsequent pod restarts causing CUDA OOM from hot restart churn (KV cache warm race). Plan: slow down restarts, clear tmp on nodes, cordon/rotate nodes, and throttle log verbosity.

 maria_oncall: initial mitigation: 1) reduce log level on modelcache to WARN via config rollout, 2) scale down non-critical replica sets to free node disk, 3) cordon one affected node and run cleanup. I'll apply (1) now.

 eli_runtime: sharing commands I'm running on node gke-usw2-serve-7:
```bash
# check disk
ssh node@gke-usw2-serve-7 'df -h /var/lib/kubelet /tmp'
# list big dirs
ssh node@gke-usw2-serve-7 'du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/* | sort -hr | head -n 20'
# remove orphan tmp shards (careful)
ssh node@gke-usw2-serve-7 'rm -rf /tmp/model-cache/*/tmp'
```

 k8s-bot: ACTION: cordon node gke-usw2-serve-7 initiated by maria_oncall. Drain paused (force=false).

 tom_sre: while cordoning, please hold new deployments to the serve-pool. I'm increasing eviction threshold temporarily on the node to reduce aggressive k8s evicts: `kubectl patch node gke-usw2-serve-7 -p '{"spec":{"evictionHard":{"ephemeral-storage":"200Mi"}}}'` (will monitor).

 maria_oncall: config rollout to modelcache loglevel=warn completed (canary to 10% pods). Reducing non-critical replicas: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/ingest-batch -n redwood-serving`

 jen_support: Customer impact update: still seeing 15% error rate on embeddings for us-west, but overall request volume is down after throttling. CS notified.

 eli_runtime: saw one pod restart loop stop after tmp cleanup, but another node gke-usw2-serve-9 still shows high /var/log usage. Proposing logrotate fix to remove old rotated logs and adjust retention.

 tom_sre: agreed. I'll run `find /var/log/redwood -type f -mtime +7 -delete` on the affected nodes and restart modelcache pods one-by-one with backoff to avoid CUDA OOM spikes.

 incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 45m. Maria remains primary until handoff unless escalated.

 maria_oncall: performing rolling restart of modelcache daemonset with 30s stagger. Command: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/modelcache -n redwood-serving --timeout=5m`

 eli_runtime: watch logs for CUDA OOM string and KV cache warmup time. If OOMs persist, we'll fallback to smaller model variant for live traffic via routing policy.

 tom_sre: quick snippet from `dmesg` on gke-usw2-serve-9 showing OOM kill after eviction: ```
[12345.678901] Killed process 23456 (modelcache) total-vm: 987654kB, anon-rss: 850000kB, file-rss: 12000kB
[12345.679012] Out of memory: Kill process 23456 (modelcache) score 987 or sacrifice child
```

 maria_oncall: status update: after cleanup and loglevel change, eviction count dropped from 6->1 in last 12m. Error rate on embeddings down to 6%. Keeping cordon on gke-usw2-serve-7 while we monitor.

 jen_support: I'll prepare a customer postmortem blurb: short summary, impacted endpoints, mitigation steps taken, timeline, and follow-ups (log retention, eviction thresholds, disk monitoring alerting).

 tom_sre: follow-ups: 1) add automated tmp cleanup job on nodes for /tmp/model-cache older than 2h, 2) add alert for ephemeral-storage > 70% on serve-pool nodes, 3) evaluate modelcache transient disk usage and move heavy shards to ephemeral persistent volumes, 4) add soft throttle on restart to prevent KV cache OOM.

 maria_oncall: handoff note for next oncall (tom_sre if not you): watch for CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY and new evictions; keep cordon while cleanup job lands. Escalate to infra if node disk can't be reclaimed.

 tom_sre: i'll take post-incident ownership. Will file incident ticket with timeline and action items. Thanks all. :pray:

 incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging at 2123456850 — monitoring phase.
